desc: Ideation: reduce the problem to a sweep over the first cut with range-decrement and suffix-max maintenance.
Implement the full Python solution with the exact 1-indexed sweep formulas and an iterative lazy segment tree supporting range add and suffix max.
Verify correctness on samples, edge cases (`N=3`, all equal, all distinct), and small random brute-force tests; fix any off-by-one or invalid-cut issues.
Ensure performance for `N = 3e5` in Python: `O(N log N)`, no recursion in the segment tree, `bytearray` for seen markers, and delete unused arrays to keep memory reasonable.
